investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Halden Outdoor (online retail); Platform: on-premises edge with two Linux NAT/egress gateways in active/active ECMP carrying all outbound traffic from the application network 10.50.0.0/16 to the internet; application tier on VMware (storefront, checkout-svc, payment-svc); external APIs for shipping rates, tax quotes and card payments; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
